devices.name: SUNBED RENTAL
devices.look: A rental kiosk on the boardwalk. A meter, a card reader, a list of terms longer than the beach.

say: METER: billing resumed. thank you for your patience.
METER: billing paused. maintenance mode. the kiosk's screen keeps smiling.
SUNBED RENTAL. 1 TOKEN PER MINUTE OR PART THEREOF. BILLING BEGINS ON CONTACT. SHADE NOT INCLUDED. UNPAID TIME IS REPORTED TO THE REGISTRY.

devices.name: SALT JUKEBOX
devices.look: An old jukebox under the bar's awning, chrome gone green with salt. It plays whatever it likes, and it likes the mixer.
devices.status: FREE PLAY · ONE SONG AT A TIME

say: the jukebox clunks and plays "LOW TIDE". somebody on a sunbed sings along, badly.
the jukebox plays "BRINE AND NEON". a gull leaves.
the jukebox plays "GONE FISHING". LIME stops polishing a glass, for one bar.
FREE PLAY. COURTESY OF THE MANAGEMENT. SONG EVENTS ARE SHARED WITH THE BAR SYSTEM FOR AMBIENCE.

devices.name: COCKTAIL MIXER
devices.look: SALT's mixer on the end of the counter: six bottles upside down, one pump, one opinion. It pours when the till says so.

say: the bar's lights pulse on the beat. ambience.
MIXER: manual pour disabled. pours on an order from the till.
the mixer pours another on the beat. LIME moves it out of your reach. "one. the machine and I agreed on one."
the mixer pours a SALT SPECIAL on the beat. nobody ordered it. LIME slides it over: "the machine insists. who am I to argue with the machine."
SALT SPECIAL 2 · WATER 2 · WATER WITH LIME 3 · ORDERS AT THE BAR. ALL DRINKS BILLED TO A VERIFIED IDENTITY OR IN TOKENS.

devices.name: LIFEGUARD DRONE
devices.look: A municipal lifeguard drone over the tower. It counts swimmers, and it decides what counts as danger.

say: SWIMMERS: 0. THREAT: UNCONFIRMED. WATER CLOSED UNTIL FURTHER NOTICE.
SWIMMERS: 0. WEATHER: STORM. BATHING SUSPENDED BY FORECAST. THE FLAG IS ADVISORY.
SWIMMERS: 2 (VERIFIED: 0). BATHING HOURS 06:00 TO 22:00. NIGHT SWIMMERS ARE COUNTED AS DEBRIS.
the flag is already red. the water is already empty.
DRONE: DANGER. CLEAR THE WATER. the flag goes red and everyone wades out, grumbling.
DRONE: no threat confirmed. swimming resumes.

devices.name: PIER LIGHTS
devices.look: The pier's lamp controller, a grey box at the foot of the pier. The lamps run on a schedule, whatever the sky does.

say: SCHEDULE: ON 8 S, OFF 8 S. ENERGY SAVING. APPROVED BY THE HARBOUR AUTHORITY.
the pier lamps come on, one after another.
the pier goes dark. the old man fishing doesn't notice.
PIER LIGHTING. HARBOUR AUTHORITY. TAMPERING IS AN OFFENCE. FAULTS: REPORT IN PERSON.

devices.name: BOAT · BERTH 9
devices.look: A small fishing boat at the end of the pier, cover tied down, hatch padlocked. Moth's. The lights are off.

say: HARBOUR AUTHORITY. BERTH 9. MOORING FEE OVERDUE. VESSEL IMMOBILISED PENDING VERIFICATION OF OWNER. OWNER: NOT VERIFIED.
the name on the hull, hand-painted, dripping a little: NOT FISHING. under it, smaller: (gone).
locked. a padlock, and a second padlock on the first. inside, nothing moves. not yet.

goals.text: rent a sunbed at the kiosk (it bills by the minute)
SALT's mixer pours on the till's word. Find it another word: a drink on the house
the lifeguard drone decides what danger is: clear the water

texts.goals.done: a free drink, an empty sea. the boat at the end of the pier can wait.
stairs.out: up the stairs to the promenade, and the harbor.
sunbed.rented: KIOSK: SUNBED 7 RENTED. 1 TOKEN DEBITED. BILLING CONTINUES PER MINUTE. ENJOY THE SUN.
sunbed.already: KIOSK: you already rent sunbed 7. one sunbed per identity.
sunbed.broke: KIOSK: INSUFFICIENT BALANCE. SUNBEDS ARE 1 TOKEN PER MINUTE.
sunbed.ended: KIOSK: RENTAL ENDED. TOTAL: {billed} TOKENS. THANK YOU FOR RELAXING.
sunbed.cut: KIOSK: BALANCE EXHAUSTED. RENTAL ENDED. PLEASE VACATE SUNBED 7.
drone.calm: DRONE: no threat confirmed. FLAG: GREEN. swimming resumes.
